Photo 2 shows the back of the phone again from a slightly different angle, with the 'SAMSUNG' logo visible and a glass display cabinet in the background with 'SEADOT GROUP' signage.
All photos show the phone being held in hand, with no screen visible, no box, no accessories, and no indication of the model name or storage capacity on the device itself.

No proof of origin is visible in the photos. The seller's claim cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The phone may not be a Galaxy S24 but a different model (e.g., S23 or S24 FE) with similar design.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front screen showing the model name in settings or a close-up of the model number on the back or in the box.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lower-tier model or unknown Samsung phone, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The phone may be damaged, non-functional, or have hardware issues (e.g., cracked screen, dead battery, water damage).
risks.proof: A video showing the phone turning on, screen functionality, camera operation, and a full inspection of all ports and buttons.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or with hidden damage, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: The phone may be blacklisted, stolen, or have an invalid IMEI.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the IMEI check from a trusted source (e.g., Samsung's official site or Nigerian NCC database) or a video showing the IMEI on the phone settings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially blacklisted or invalid, which reduces value and increases risk.

risks.risk: The phone may not have 8GB RAM and 128GB storage as claimed.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the phone's settings showing the model, RAM, and storage details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lower specs (e.g., 6GB/128GB or 8GB/256GB), which affects value.

proof_requests: A clear photo or video of the front screen showing the model name in settings.
A video showing the phone turning on, screen, camera, and all buttons working.
A screenshot of the IMEI check from a trusted source.
A screenshot of the phone's settings showing RAM and storage details.
